COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0) is identified and presented (coordinate set) and a separate origin/status field exists for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to a content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly identifies content (red) and its coordinate attribute for a current referent.

D.rationale: A separate origin/status field is attributed to the same identified content referent.

O.rationale: The content is presented as a spatial/constituent pattern (coordinate set) for the referent.
